references.text: Abraham buys the cave of Machpelah from Ephron the Hittite and buries Sarah there, establishing the site as the family burial place.
Isaac and Ishmael bury their father Abraham in the cave of Machpelah, next to Sarah.
Isaac dies and is buried by his sons Esau and Jacob.
Jacob gives instructions to be buried in the cave of Machpelah and names those already buried there – direct context to verse 31.
Jacob asks to be buried with his fathers, which prepares for the more detailed instruction in 49:29-31.
Jacob's sons fulfill his wish and bury him in the cave of Machpelah, next to Abraham, Sarah, Isaac, Rebekah, and Leah.
Confirms the fulfillment of Abraham's purchase of the cave of Machpelah as the burial place for the patriarchs.
Establishes the geographical and historical basis for Sarah being mentioned as buried in Machpelah.
